# get_chain_file { #geneinfo.lift.get_chain_file }

```python
geneinfo.lift.get_chain_file(
    from_assembly,
    to_assembly,
    cache_dir=None,
    overwrite=False,
)
```

Path to a UCSC chain file, downloading it if it is not cached.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**from_assembly**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   UCSC name of the source assembly, e.g. ``'hg38'``.

<code>[**to_assembly**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   UCSC name of the target assembly, e.g. ``'papAnu4'``.

<code>[**cache_dir**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[PathLike](`geneinfo.lift.PathLike`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Directory for the downloaded chain files. Defaults to ``~/.cache/geneinfo/chains``.

<code>[**overwrite**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Download again even if the file is cached.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Path to the gzipped chain file.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
get_chain_file('hg38', 'papAnu4')
```
